title: Break Up the Hard Ground
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who takes a breath and starts again, and tonight Hosea asks for the hard, quiet work of breaking up ground that has gone crusty. Setting the fallen blocks down and building the bottom row again, wider, is exactly Beau’s kind of steady courage.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because starting over takes steady courage. In Beau’s world today: Beau’s block tower fell over three times, and his chest went tight and hot. He set the blocks down, took a breath, and started the bottom row again, wider this time. Just like the farmer who breaks up the hard ground before planting, Beau learned that the hard, quiet work comes first.
